label: Bible Study
prompt: What man of you, having an hundred _____, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
verse: What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it?
note: The lost sheep — first of three 'lost' parables in Luke 15, followed by a coin and a son.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great _____. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
verse: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
note: After a long drought and seven trips to look for a cloud, there was a great rain.

label: Sunday School
prompt: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O thou man of God, there is _____ in the pot. And they could not eat thereof.
verse: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O thou man of God, there is death in the pot. And they could not eat thereof.
note: 'There is death in the pot!' — the prophets' stew was rescued when Elisha tossed in some meal.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Esteeming the _____ of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
verse: Esteeming the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
note: Moses traded Egypt's treasures for the reproach of God's people — Hebrews calls it the better investment.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Moreover, because I have set my _____ to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,
verse: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my God, I have of mine own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,
note: David gave his own treasure for the temple 'because I have set my affection to the house of my God.' Giving follows the heart.
